title: Pushback in Nigeria over ex-Boko Haram fighter reintegration
contentSnippet: Nigeria is set to reintegrate more than 700 former Boko Haram fighters into society under a government deradicalization program. Authorities say this is key to ending the insurgency — but communities are skeptical.
